items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: I took Shipman down to the union, and Shipman was ordered to pay all the musicians, so Shipman fired me out of a' job

ctx.x: It wouldn't be like a high class pimp, would he?

Yeah, just like one. And I took Shipman down to the union, and Shipman was ordered to pay all the musicians, so Shipman fired me out of a' job, see. And I used to hang around the theatre there, and one day I caught Shipman out on the side, and I said, 'You act like a kid, when a kid hits you, the kid cries, and you're doing that to me -- I couldn't pay them guys, them guys are looking for the money, and you're letting the man run off with all the money. And just because I took you down to the union, you fired me…
So after awhile, let me see, he kept me out of the theatre for nearly a year ...
